# nb-studio design

## design approve

Approve an issue’s design proposal

The owner, the project lead or an administrator moves the issue to In progress; an optional comment goes with it.

```bash
nb-studio design approve <issue>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `issue`  |             |

| Flag        | Type   | Description                |
| ----------- | ------ | -------------------------- |
| `--comment` | string | (or --comment-file <path>) |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/designProposals/{issueId}/approve` (`designProposalsApprove`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio design approve PM-12
```

## design get

Get an issue’s design proposal

The issue is named by id or identifier.

```bash
nb-studio design get <issue>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `issue`  |             |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/designProposals/{issueId}` (`designProposalsGetProposal`)

## design request-changes

Send an issue’s design proposal back

Anyone who may comment on the issue writes why (`comment` is required) and moves it back to Analysis.

```bash
nb-studio design request-changes <issue>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `issue`  |             |

| Flag        | Type   | Description                |
| ----------- | ------ | -------------------------- |
| `--comment` | string | (or --comment-file <path>) |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/designProposals/{issueId}/requestChanges` (`designProposalsRequestChanges`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio design request-changes PM-12 --comment "Split the migration out."
```
